sections.title: The Covenant Proposal: Treasured Possession and Priestly Kingdom

blocks.text: Moses ascends the mountain and receives words from God to speak to the people. The heart of this message rests on a foundation of memory: God reminds Israel of what has already transpired—deliverance from Egypt and safe passage through the wilderness. On this solid ground of prior deliverance, God makes a conditional offer: if Israel obeys God's voice and keeps the covenant, then Israel shall be God's own possession from among all peoples, a kingdom of priests, and a holy nation. This identification of Israel occurs before the legal requirements are spelled out, establishing that election and possession are God's gift; obedience and law follow as Israel's response to grace already received.
